cards.title: Convertible Bond Anatomy and Cashflows
cards.summary_curated: A convertible bond is a corporate-debt instrument whose holder owns an embedded right to surrender the bond for a fixed number of issuer shares; until conversion or maturity it pays coupons like an ordinary corporate bond, with conversion price K_c = F / q derived from face F and conversion ratio q, and call/put provisions modifying the bond-plus-call decomposition.

cards.title: Bond Floor (Investment Value)
